reason: Mechanism v1 found stronger held-out role decoding but its 18-dimensional role swap did not consistently exceed an 18-dimensional random swap. This follow-up separates role order from unordered identity in the same fitted readout.
models: Same 16 frozen checkpoints as mechanism v1: eight fresh graphs, seed 271001, ordered and unordered auxiliary arms.
probe_data: Same observed-pair scene suite and fixed ridge readout as mechanism v1. No unseen-pair fitting.
role_order_subspace: Top nine singular vectors of W_source minus W_target, where W are the observed-only final-scene readout weights.
identity_subspace: Top nine singular vectors of W_source plus W_target, from the same readout.
controls: Five random nine-dimensional subspaces per graph with deterministic seeds, plus no intervention and full embedding swap.
intervention_data: The same second-rendering 25 unseen pairs times 128 balanced episodes per pair used in mechanism v1.
outcomes: Binary role accuracy and mean correct-minus-reversed margin after swapping each subspace between correct and reversed candidates; fraction of the candidate-difference energy captured by each subspace.
analysis: Report every graph and both arms. This is an exploratory follow-up selected after v1, not a preregistered confirmation of a unique circuit.
